title: Recalling the 1938 personnel before the Cincinnati trip
summary: The brothers try to recall who went to Cincinnati in 1938, including Hudson, Crack Stanley, Chester Lane, Bill Martin and two trombonists.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: But the band played at the Club Plantation through '37 into '38. At the end of '38, we still had Eugene Porter, we had -- I think -- George Hudson -- did we have George? Did George leave the band in '38?
Hudson Hutchison, we had George Hudson, we had --
Merle ... [WALTER] -ed. Crack Stanley, and to Cincinnati,
Bill did CRACK go with us?
We had Tarrant went, didn't he?
Yeah. Tarrant Floyd George Smith -- let me see if (unintelligible), George Smith, and Skins and Chester Lane.
Seemed to me we had two trombones -- I don't know, seems to me we had two trombones. I don't guess -- was it Bone and Torran?
(unintelligible) John Orange, his name was John Orange.
George Hudson, Bill Martin, and Crack (unintelligible)
Crack Stanley (unintelligible) and Bill Martin saw that no-hitter game, and I missed it.
